scope: Complete file records referenced by the companion provenance. These paths are not retired by batch 43. A null current_tree means an earlier historical-retention state, not an instruction to remove or fabricate an input.
identity_policy: sha256_evidence distinguishes an independent whole small-file hash from the value in a retained contemporaneous complete manifest. Git blob/size/commit entries were actually retrieved as metadata; large bodies were not fetched. Historical recovery must satisfy the original consumer's unchanged whole-file SHA.
